description: Cloud provider API responses for selfhost up, taken from the providers' published OpenAPI documents (examples, or schema examples where an operation has none). No account was used.

files.hetzner/servers-create.json: POST /servers 201 example, root_password set to null as for a server created with an SSH key
files.hetzner/error-resource_unavailable.json: written in the documented error format with the documented resource_unavailable code
files.digitalocean/droplets-create.json: POST /v2/droplets 202 Single Droplet Create Response example
files.digitalocean/droplets-get.json: GET /v2/droplets/{droplet_id} 200 example: active, with public networks
